expressions.calm: calm and attentive: relaxed brow, steady eyes, neutral closed mouth
expressions.worried: worried and anxious: brows drawn together and raised, tense eyes, lips pressed tight
expressions.shocked: shocked disbelief: eyes wide, brows raised high, mouth slightly open, frozen
expressions.angry: angry and confrontational: brows pulled down hard, narrowed eyes, jaw clenched, mouth tense as if speaking sharply
expressions.grieving: grieving: eyes wet with tears, brows pulled up and together, mouth trembling slightly open, overwhelmed by sudden loss
expressions.relieved: relieved and softened: brows relaxed, eyes softening, a slight tired smile, shoulders lowered
